sast.title: ReactMarkdown is configured with the `rehypeRaw` plugin, which allows raw HTML in markdown to pass through unsanitized. This creates an XSS vulnerability if the markdown content originates from untrusted sources (user input, API responses, AI-generated content). Add `rehypeSanitize` to the rehype plugin chain to sanitize HTML, or remove `rehypeRaw` if raw HTML rendering is not needed.
